edits.before: Q the rebound through the pair, warm the carry, auto — the burn ledger compounds while the buttons wait.
edits.after: E has two charges — pre-shield your ADC before he opens with the Q/W split-poke rotation, then bank the second for his R beam.

edits.after: Organic Deconstruction and his R both convert to true damage at 3 stacks — armor and MR don't reduce that burst, so answer with distance, not resistances.
